title: Policy propagation delay caused variant thundering herd and cross-region fallback oscillation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Incident summary: On 2025-02-17 a propagation delay in remote routing policy updates caused a window where routers used stale policy state. This led to a sudden simultaneous reroute of many requests to a smaller set of variants (some incompatible for certain sequence lengths), producing increased tail latency and a cascading cross-region fallback oscillation. The observable effects were: elevated 95/99th latency, spike in variant-incompatible errors, and repeated cross-region reroutes (bounce) that amplified load on a single region. This ticket collects follow-ups, mitigations already deployed, and longer-term hardening work.
comments: 2025-02-17 03:14 UTC - Incident detected via console: routing anomalies dashboard showed 8x rise in variant-mismatch errors. Pager duty triggered for routing-safety on-call.

2025-02-17 03:22 UTC - Initial mitigation: temporarily increased route-stickiness TTL to keep sessions on previously healthy variants while we investigated propagation state. This reduced churn but did not eliminate tail spikes.

2025-02-17 04:05 UTC - Root cause hypothesis: remote policy propagation from the control plane to edge routers experienced a ~90s delivery window due to a combination of backlog in the policy stream processor and a large config snapshot roll. During that window, some routers read mixed/partial state resulting in a large fraction of requests being routed to a narrower set of variants.

2025-02-17 05:30 UTC - Hotfix deployed: added a temporary safety gate in the router that rejects incomplete policy snapshots (requires full-version stamp or fallback to last-known-good). Rollout to 3/4 of edge fleet by 05:30, full rollout completed 06:10 UTC.

2025-02-18 09:40 UTC - Post-incident analysis: cache invalidation race identified between policy-stream consumer and local policy cache writer leading to inconsistent variant weights until next checkpoint. Also found a missing monotonicity check in policy apply logic.
2025-02-20 14:00 UTC - Product and SRE agreed to adopt a two-phase apply for any policy that changes variant weights >10% across >10k routes to avoid sudden global swings.
2025-02-21 11:12 UTC - Design note: consider adding per-customer gradual rollout windows when policy changes cross quantization/quantized-variant boundaries to prevent variant incompatibility.
2025-02-24 16:28 UTC - Observability gaps: no single metric tracked 'policy snapshot completeness' per router; added temporary synthetic gauge derived from apply success events to the dashboard.
2025-02-25 08:02 UTC - This ticket created to track remaining hardening, engineering work, and runbook updates. See action items below.
action_items: Add monotonic version check in policy apply path and fail-safe to reject partial snapshots (owner: Jonas Müller, estimate: 3, due: 2025-03-03)
Implement two-phase policy apply for large-weight changes (>10% / >10k routes) with gradual step-down/step-up intervals (owner: Maria Chen, estimate: 5, due: 2025-03-12)
Introduce 'policy_snapshot_completeness' metric per router and alert if apply takes longer than 30s (owner: Ravi Singh, estimate: 3, due: 2025-03-01)
Backfill end-to-end tests that simulate staggered policy propagation across 3 regions and ensure no route oscillations occur under backlog (owner: Priya Rao, estimate: 5, due: 2025-03-15)

Update routing runbook: include TL;DR for when to increase route-stickiness TTL, how to apply emergency gating, and steps to rollback policy snapshots (owner: Oncall Rotation, estimate: 2, due: 2025-02-28)
Evaluate and adopt exponential backoff + damping factor in cross-region reroute logic to avoid immediate re-fanout after failure (owner: Kenji Watanabe, estimate: 5, due: 2025-03-10)
Audit any code paths that map variant tags to model binary to ensure compatibility checks include sequence length/quantization expectations (owner: Aisha Patel, estimate: 3, due: 2025-03-05)
Add chaos test that temporarily pauses policy stream consumer for 120s in staging to validate safe behavior (owner: Site Reliability, estimate: 3, due: 2025-03-08)
Create postmortem summary for C-suite and affected customers (owner: PM - Elena García, estimate: 2, due: 2025-02-27)
Schedule delivery review during runtime-1.20 planning meeting and include rollout gating as a release criterion (owner: Product, due: 2025-03-01)
Remove hotfix 'reject-partial-snapshots' toggle after MONOTONIC check and tests pass (owner: Jonas Müller, estimate: 1, due: 2025-03-04)
